chunks: From him, from Safwan, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees blood while she is pregnant, just as she used to see before that in every month: should she leave the salat (prayer)?
So he said: She leaves it if it continues.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: salat (prayer), which may be left under the stated condition
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Should a pregnant woman stop praying if she sees blood during pregnancy?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of a pregnant woman who sees blood similar to her regular monthly bleeding. Imam Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام states that she leaves the salat (prayer) if the bleeding continues, indicating a legal criterion tied to the persistence of the blood.
